limits.parent_and_child_accounting: Each slot is one bounded native host session containing exactly one intended Foundry role delegation. Parent orchestration requests, child requests, fallback requests and all tokens count within the slot. No uncounted preparatory model call.
limits.on_timeout_partial_limit_or_billing_risk: Stop/cancel; record cancelled or unavailable; do not resume, retry or replace. Preserve incumbent.
limits.context_accounting: At most four parent host sessions plus four delegated child contexts, unlike Codex four standalone contexts. All parent/child calls and tokens share each slot 20-minute limit and zero retries; no fifth host session.

preflight_before_any_dispatch: Record approval of exact ADR text and contract digest, selected apex branch, authenticated machine/provider, binary path/version, Foundry loaded ref/version and source/install mode. No execution approval is inferred from this proposal.
Revalidate official source compatibility, actual selected account entitlement and included billing for all intended parent and child models. auth status and a model announcement are insufficient.

Inspect effective child environment names and managed/project/user restrictions without exposing values/secrets; preserve R6 real HOME/LANG/LC_ALL/LOGNAME/PATH/TMPDIR/USER identity. No persistent edits.
Validate JSON, exact static packet digests, expected implementer result hash and all deterministic tests at candidate SHA before native execution.

Record preflight start timestamp; select FIRST eligible normal PAT-16 PR head observed after it starts with 40-hex base/head and passing deterministic tests at exact head. Freeze PR URL, base/head SHA, git diff SHA-256, issue AC digest, ADR/contract digest, test commands/results and reviewer-claim coordinates before ANY slot. No synthetic review or PAT-15 proof reuse.

Materialize statics 1/2/4 in an isolated temporary fixture outside development checkout; bind outer Goal/Inputs/Constraints/Done when packet and fixture digest; never modify exact reused inner fixtures.
Prove supported native Agent boundary and available execution evidence without a model probe. If not established, mark relevant slots unavailable and do not spend to discover it.
Reserve all slot budgets before start; any changed contract, role, candidate, corpus or billing branch returns to human approval before dispatch.

native_execution.required_boundary: Real Claude Code host session with Foundry plugin loaded, logical foundry:Lupin/Eiffel/Maigret/Vauban Agent dispatch through route_agent hook and routed capability/effort profile; preserve native session and child correlation.
native_execution.not_equivalent: Four plain claude -p top-level prompts labeled with role names do not exercise Agent dispatch, hook rewrites, role permissions, effort frontmatter, reviewer claims or blank context; they cannot qualify delegation. A -p parent is allowed only if the real intended Agent dispatch and evidence are established and all parent/child usage remains included and bounded.
native_execution.wire: Explicit full model ID per Agent invocation; effort via appropriate routed subagent frontmatter. Haiku uses an effort-free capability profile with no effort parameter. Model and effort in a plan are transmitted intent only.
native_execution.permissions: Preserve current readonly vs worker tools and guard; no Agent/Task tool inside the delegated role; no broader permission mode. Worker writes only isolated fixture. Reviewer/architect remain readonly.
native_execution.review: Normal deterministic claim, blank context, two-stage AC/quality review; no implementer history or answer leakage.
native_execution.turn_caps: Retain role ceilings 10/50/24/30 and packet ceilings 4000/12000/16000/10000, max_turns tool field and installed maxTurns only where supported; timeout/partial is not success.
native_execution.on_override_restriction_refusal_or_safet: Observe/diagnose supported metadata; preserve provider refusal and floors. No certified requested profile from substituted identity or capped effort. Unavailable is not success; no automatic replacement.
native_execution.cli_local_preflight: Coordinator read --help for 2.1.285 without a model call: --agent/--agents/--model/--effort exist. --agent selects the current-session role and alone does not exercise Agent tool hook rewrite/claim. A native --agent run can prove only its declared-role boundary, not the required Agent-tool path. No substitution of one for the other. --bare is forbidden: API-only/OAuth disabled.
native_execution.parent: Proposed parent model claude-sonnet-5-5/medium, included subscription access revalidated before dispatch; never Fable. Disposable bounded parent definition, at most two agentic turns, one Agent call to the intended role, no resume/nested delegation. Parent tool access narrowed to Agent plus only required readonly observation; no shell/edit/tracker mutation. Preflight must demonstrate supported parent turn/tool caps without a model call; otherwise stop unavailable, do not relax caps.
native_execution.worktree: Scratch fixture/isolated review checkout only; no write authority to the development checkout or existing evidence. Use source plugin via supported --plugin-dir only after approval, capture actual loaded ref/version; manifest 0.9.0 alone is not loaded native version proof.
native_execution.host_mode: Capture native mode only if exposed; otherwise null/unavailable, never assume Standard/Fast equivalence.

result_contract.identity_evidence: Native host metadata bound to actual child/session and request, including precise model ID and effective effort or native not-applicable state. A family-only /tasks display is diagnostic, not exact-ID proof. Retain null if absent. Reject self text, agent name, configured route, transmitted parameter, plan or generated receipt as observation.
result_contract.actual_usage: After session termination, explicit offline host-log reader under ADR-0015 extracts allowed actual input/cache-read/cache-write/output/reasoning token counters and provenance, parent and child separately; never infer from prompt size or plan. Missing counters null/unavailable, never 0. Missing required identity/effective effort or unbindable usage prevents complete qualification. No raw logs/prompts/responses/paths/secrets exported into passive telemetry.
result_contract.artifact_boundary: Contract/corpus digests live in qualification evidence under existing mechanisms, not ADR-0008 passive telemetry. No new evidence store or raw-log upload.
